title: 桑切斯在彭博直言：边境经济差距是根源，摩洛哥正在行动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yeah, high-level meetings of the UN General Assembly continue this week bringing global leaders to New York City and to Bloomberg World Headquarters. Right now in our New York studio, Bloomberg's Francine Laquois, sitting down with the Prime Minister of Spain, Pedro
segments.zh: 联合国大会高级别会议本周继续，全球领导人齐聚纽约和彭博全球总部。现在在纽约演播室，彭博的弗朗辛·拉夸斯与西班牙首相桑切斯对话。

segments.en: Sanchez. Yeah, thank you both. We're delighted to be joined by the Prime Minister of Spain, Mr.
segments.zh: 桑切斯。谢谢你们。我们很高兴邀请到西班牙首相桑切斯先生。

segments.en: Pedro Sanchez. Thank you so much for joining us here at Bloomberg Global Headquarters.
segments.zh: 桑切斯。非常感谢您来到彭博全球总部。

segments.en: Now it's been about two months since the mass arrival in Toyota, beyond what has circulated on social media. Do you now know whether any state or organization facilitated what you
segments.zh: 距离大批人员抵达托约塔已约两个月，社交媒体上流传着各种说法。您现在是否知道是否有任何国家或组织协助了您所称的对西班牙主权的攻击？

segments.en: called an attack on Spanish sovereignty? We're still investigating what happened, those days, but there's some certainties. The first one is the economic gap between one side
segments.zh: 我们仍在调查当时发生的情况，但有一些确定因素。第一是边境一侧与另一侧之间的经济差距，即摩洛哥与西班牙之间。

segments.en: of the border and the other side of the border, between Morocco and Spain. Second, the use of social media to expand misinformation about the situation in Spain and Toyota. And last but
segments.zh: 第二，利用社交媒体扩大关于西班牙和托约塔局势的虚假信息。最后但同样重要的是，双方都证实了边境控制机制，当然包括西班牙。

segments.en: not least, a border control mechanism that has been proved by both sides, of course, Spain
segments.zh: 当然还有摩洛哥。我们与摩洛哥关系很好。我们在许多问题上合作，不仅是经济方面，还有打击恐怖主义，当然还有打击走私和非正常移民。

segments.en: and of course Morocco. And with Morocco, we have a great relationship. We cooperate on many issues, not only economically, but also fighting against terrorism and, of course, fighting
segments.zh: 所以我们有非常积极的合作。我们要求了答复，也要求了行动，他们确实在采取这些行动。

segments.en: against smugglers and irregular migration. So we have a very positive cooperation. We have asked for answers, and also for actions, and they are certainly taking those actions.
segments.zh: 打击走私和非常规移民。合作非常积极。我们要求回应，也要求行动，他们确实在采取行动。
